title: Code: Cosine similarity vs. Pearson correlation

cues.en: Mike: Now I'd like to explore the cosine similarity measure and the relationship between the Pearson correlation coefficient and cosine similarity.
cues.zh: Mike：現在想探索餘弦相似度，以及皮爾森相關係數與餘弦相似度之間的關係。

cues.en: And I'm gonna do this by simulating data and incorporating something that you've already learned about previously in this section, which is generating random data
cues.zh: 我會模擬資料，並結合本單元前面學過的內容，也就是產生

cues.en: that has a specified correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 具有指定相關係數的隨機資料。

cues.en: So let me first scroll down to this, inside this for loop here so you get an idea of what we're doing.
cues.zh: 先往下捲到這個 for 迴圈內，讓你知道要做什麼。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do is generate some random data, compute the Pearson correlation coefficient between variables x and y, and then I'm going
cues.zh: 我要產生隨機資料，計算 X 與 Y 的皮爾森相關係數，再

cues.en: to compute cosine similarity between those same two variables.
cues.zh: 計算同一對變數的餘弦相似度。

cues.en: So here, I have the numerator, so this is the cosine similarity numerator, and that is the element-wise multiplication of the two variables, and then sum.
cues.zh: 這裡是餘弦相似度的分子，也就是把兩個變數逐元素相乘，再加總。

cues.en: Now, notice I'm not subtracting the mean, that's the key difference with the correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 注意，沒有減去平均值，這是與相關係數的關鍵差異。

cues.en: So here is the element-wise multiplication and sum, and then here is the denominator, that's the square root of something that actually looks pretty similar here,
cues.zh: 這裡逐元素相乘再加總，這裡則是分母，對一個看起來相當類似的量開平方根，

cues.en: except here, it's the sum of x times y, here, it's the sum of x times x, and then it's the square root of that, again, this is also the same thing as the norm
cues.zh: 但這裡是 X 乘 Y 的總和，這裡是 X 乘 X 的總和，再開平方根；用線性代數的說法，這也就是

cues.en: of vector x in linear algebra speak.
cues.zh: 向量 X 的範數。

cues.en: And then multiply that by the square root of the sum of y times y.
cues.zh: 再乘上 Y 乘 Y 的總和的平方根。

cues.en: So then we have our cosine similarity, which is, it's just this ratio, and this is exactly the translation of the formula that I showed into MATLAB code.
cues.zh: 得到餘弦相似度，就是這個比值，這正是把投影片中的公式轉成 MATLAB 程式碼。

cues.en: Okay, so the idea is that we generate some data and compute the correlation and cosine similarity, and then we'll do a little bit of plotting to see whether those are the same or different.
cues.zh: 概念是，產生資料、計算相關與餘弦相似度，再稍微畫圖，看看它們相同還是不同。

cues.en: Now, these two lines of code show the method of generating two variables with a specified correlation between them, exactly as you learned several videos ago.
cues.zh: 這兩行程式碼就是產生具有指定相關的兩個變數的方法，與幾支影片之前學到的完全相同。

cues.en: It was called, I think that was called something like simulate data with specified correlation.
cues.zh: 那支影片的名稱，我想大概是「模擬具有指定相關的資料」。

cues.en: Okay, and so then, so now I'm going to generate correlation coefficients between minus one and plus one.
cues.zh: 接著要產生負 1 到正 1 之間的相關係數。

cues.en: Now, there's no particularly special reason why we have to set up the code like this to impose the correlations.
cues.zh: 其實沒有什麼特別理由，一定要這樣安排程式碼，來施加相關。

cues.en: We could have also done this with just random numbers and see what the correlations happen to be, in randomly sampled data, they'd all be, you know, generally close to zero with some spread.
cues.zh: 也可以直接用隨機數，看相關剛好是多少；隨機抽樣的資料通常會接近 0，帶有一些分散。

cues.en: But there is one reason why I wanted to show this range of correlations, which is to allow you to see the differences between the correlation
cues.zh: 但我想展示這一系列相關，是為了讓你看清楚相關

cues.en: and cosine similarity and also to see that those differences and similarities are not, you know, it's not some special case of a correlation of zero
cues.zh: 與餘弦相似度的差異，也讓你知道這些差異與相似處，並不是零相關

cues.en: or a correlation of one, so it's, the relationship is general across all these different correlation values.
cues.zh: 或相關為 1 的特殊情況，而是普遍存在於這些不同的相關值。

cues.en: Okay, and then we'll get back to this in a moment.
cues.zh: 稍後再回到這裡。

cues.en: So let's see, and then I'm gonna plot them, so I'll just run all this code.
cues.zh: 接著畫圖，我直接執行全部程式碼。

cues.en: So here, we have on the x axis, the requested or the theoretical correlation.
cues.zh: X 軸是要求的相關，或理論相關。

cues.en: And on the y axis is the empirical correlation, I guess there's probably, this, a label probably should say correlation or cosine similarity.
cues.zh: Y 軸是經驗相關，我想標籤大概應該寫成「相關或餘弦相似度」。

cues.en: And so, in fact, you don't even see the correlation here because you just see the cosine similarity, but these two measures are so similar that they overlap nearly everywhere.
cues.zh: 這裡其實看不到相關，只看到餘弦相似度，因為兩個指標非常接近，幾乎處處重疊。

cues.en: It looks like, you know, if you would, I can see this on my screen, I don't know if you can see it on yours, but when you run this on your computer, you'll be able to see a couple of tiny differences here
cues.zh: 我在螢幕上看得到，不知道你是否看得到，但在自己的電腦執行時，可以看到幾個非常微小的差異，

cues.en: and there.
cues.zh: 在這裡與那裡。

cues.en: Nonetheless, they are basically the same, that you see here as well, this is a plot of the correlation coefficient versus cosine similarity for each of these, how many did I do here?
cues.zh: 總之，基本上一樣。這張圖也看得到，這是每次迭代的相關係數與餘弦相似度對照，一共做了多少次？

cues.en: For each of these 100 different iterations through this loop, each of these different datasets.
cues.zh: 是這個迴圈的 100 次不同迭代，每次一份不同資料集。

cues.en: So it's pretty obvious that they correlate at basically one.
cues.zh: 很明顯，它們的相關基本上為 1。

cues.en: And you can also see that here, that's the very end of the code, and I just dump out the corr of corrs and the, it's the correlation of correlations, it's a little,
cues.zh: 這裡也能看到，在程式碼最後，我輸出 corrs 的 corr，也就是相關的相關，

cues.en: it's a lot of correlations going on here.
cues.zh: 這裡真是有很多相關。

cues.en: But this is the correlation between the Pearson correlation coefficient and the cosine similarity, so they're basically perfectly correlated.
cues.zh: 這是皮爾森相關係數與餘弦相似度之間的相關，基本上完全相關。

cues.en: Now, we know why these are very closely correlated, but there is occasionally a tiny, tiny divergence between them.
cues.zh: 我們知道為什麼它們高度相關，但偶爾仍有非常微小的偏離。

cues.en: And if you are not sure yet but would like to think about it, then please pause the video and think about why, in this case, the way I set up this code here, why are the correlation
cues.zh: 如果還不確定，想思考一下，請暫停影片，想想這個程式安排下，為什麼相關

cues.en: and cosine similarity nearly identical, but not necessarily always giving exactly, exactly the same number?
cues.zh: 與餘弦相似度幾乎相同，卻不一定每次都精確得到同一個數字？

cues.en: Okay, so the answer is that, I mentioned in the slides in the previous video that these two measures are identical to each other when the data are already zero-meaned,
cues.zh: 答案是，上一支影片投影片提過，當資料已經零均值化，

cues.en: when they have a mean of zero.
cues.zh: 也就是平均值為 0 時，兩個指標會完全相同。

cues.en: And that is kind of close to the case here because I'm generating normally distributed random numbers, so the expected mean of x is zero
cues.zh: 這裡大致接近那種情況，因為產生的是常態分布隨機數，X 的期望平均值是 0，

cues.en: and the expected mean of y is also zero.
cues.zh: Y 的期望平均值也是 0。

cues.en: So that's what makes them so close to each other.
cues.zh: 所以兩者非常接近。

cues.en: Now, of course, empirically, the mean, we can even see this, the mean is not going to be exactly, exactly zero.
cues.zh: 但實際上，平均值不會精確等於 0，我們甚至可以查看。

cues.en: So the mean of x is minus 0.013, and it doesn't even matter what the mean of y is.
cues.zh: X 的平均值是負 0.013，Y 的平均值是多少甚至不重要。

cues.en: So the means aren't exactly, exactly zero.
cues.zh: 所以平均值不是精確的 0。

cues.en: So that creates these tiny, tiny divergences between these two measures, okay, that's one thing.
cues.zh: 這就造成兩個指標之間非常微小的偏離，這是一點。

cues.en: So now what I want to do is show how these two measures start differing from each other, and they start differing from each other when the data are not mean-centered.
cues.zh: 現在想示範它們如何開始不同：當資料沒有平均中心化時，就會開始出現差異。

cues.en: So what I'm gonna do is add a really large offset.
cues.zh: 我要加上一個很大的位移。

cues.en: Now, 10, you know, depending on your reference frame, 10 is either a large number or not a large number.
cues.zh: 10 是大還是小，取決於參照尺度。

cues.en: But considering what these numbers look like, let me, let's see, so plot x, so considering that these data have a mean of zero and a variance of one,
cues.zh: 但考慮這些數字的樣子，看看，plot X；這些資料平均值是 0，變異數是 1，

cues.en: adding 10 is a pretty significant change.
cues.zh: 所以加上 10，是非常大的改變。

cues.en: We're really adding a huge offset to this dataset.
cues.zh: 相當於替資料集加上巨大的位移。

cues.en: Okay, so then I'm just gonna rerun the entire code.
cues.zh: 接著重新執行全部程式碼。

cues.en: So now you see that's we're starting to get quite a noticeable difference between the correlation coefficient and cosine similarity.
cues.zh: 現在可以看到，相關係數與餘弦相似度之間，開始有相當明顯的差異。

cues.en: Now, the correlation coefficient isn't really changing from run to run.
cues.zh: 每次執行時，相關係數其實不太改變。

cues.en: Of course, it's changing a tiny, tiny bit because these are random numbers, but overall, the correlation coefficient isn't going to change because this sort of mean offset
cues.zh: 當然，因為是隨機數，還是會有非常微小的改變；但整體而言，相關係數不會改變，因為這種平均值位移，

cues.en: doesn't affect the correlation, of course, that's how the correlation coefficient works, it subtracts the mean.
cues.zh: 不影響相關。相關係數的運作方式，就是先減掉平均值。

cues.en: So changing the mean has zero effect on the correlation between two variables.
cues.zh: 所以改變平均值，對兩個變數的相關沒有影響。

cues.en: But the cosine similarity does not subtract the mean.
cues.zh: 但餘弦相似度不會減掉平均值。

cues.en: And so we actually have a difference between cosine similarity and correlation in terms of magnitude.
cues.zh: 因此，餘弦相似度與相關，在數值大小上出現差異。

cues.en: If you look at the overall relationship, you can see that there's still a pretty tight relationship, in this case, they're correlated at 0.83.
cues.zh: 如果看整體關係，仍然很緊密；這裡兩者的相關是 0.83。

cues.en: So it's still a pretty strong relationship, the correlation and cosine similarity are still measuring very similar things, but as soon as you add a mean offset,
cues.zh: 仍然很強，相關與餘弦相似度仍在衡量非常類似的東西，但只要加入平均值位移，

cues.en: they're not going to give identical results.
cues.zh: 就不會得到完全相同的結果。

cues.en: Now, we could, you know, ponder for a moment about whether that makes sense and which measure is quote unquote better.
cues.zh: 可以想一下，這是否合理，哪個指標算是「比較好」。

cues.en: Obviously, neither of these is better, they're just a little bit different.
cues.zh: 顯然沒有哪一個比較好，只是有點不同。

cues.en: But it is interesting to see, so, you know, they're crossing zero at the same point, so when one is negative, the other one's gonna be negative, when one is positive, the other one's gonna be positive,
cues.zh: 不過有趣的是，它們在相同位置跨過 0，所以一個為負時，另一個也為負；一個為正時，另一個也為正，

cues.en: you know, a little bit of noise notwithstanding.
cues.zh: 先不計一些雜訊。

cues.en: But which one of these two measures makes more sense depends on how you are viewing the data.
cues.zh: 哪一個比較有意義，取決於你如何看待資料。

cues.en: If you view this mean offset, this large offset, between the variables x and y as a meaningful difference, then yeah, actually, you know, these are less similar,
cues.zh: 如果認為 X 與 Y 之間，這個很大的平均值位移是有意義的差異，那麼確實，它們比較不相似，

cues.en: x and y are less similar to each other in some sense by adding this large offset to x.
cues.zh: 在 X 加上這個大位移後，某種程度上，X 與 Y 彼此更不相似。

cues.en: And so the cosine similarity is picking up on that.
cues.zh: 餘弦相似度就會捕捉到這一點。

cues.en: Now, the correlation actually says that, you know, we should care about whether these two variables are generally going up and down together and whether they make big jumps up together or,
cues.zh: 而相關認為，我們該關心的是兩個變數是否大致一起上下變化，是否一起大幅跳升，

cues.en: versus small jumps up together, and it doesn't really matter what the absolute scale is.
cues.zh: 或一起小幅跳升，而絕對尺度並不重要。

cues.en: So the correlation was kind of designed for something like, you know, correlating height and weight where you have totally different scales and you want the correlation between height
cues.zh: 所以相關是為了這類情況設計的，例如計算身高與體重的相關，它們的尺度完全不同，而且希望身高

cues.en: and weight to be the same, even though, you know, height is measured in inches or centimeters and weight is measured in pounds or kilograms or picograms.
cues.zh: 與體重之間的相關，不會因為身高以英吋或公分量測，體重以磅、公斤或皮克量測，而有所不同。

cues.en: So all of those different scales produce identical correlations, but the exact numbers are differing, and so the cosine similarity is gonna pick up
cues.zh: 這些不同尺度都會產生相同相關，但具體數字不同，因此餘弦相似度會捕捉到

cues.en: on that difference.
cues.zh: 那個差異。

cues.en: Okay, so that's a little bit about correlation versus cosine similarity.
cues.zh: 以上是相關與餘弦相似度的比較。

cues.en: The last thing I wanna show here is that you can also implement cosine similarity here in MATLAB using the pdist function.
cues.zh: 最後示範，在 MATLAB 中也可以用 pdist 函式實作餘弦相似度。

cues.en: So what I'm doing is inputting variables x and y as a vector, sorry, as a matrix.
cues.zh: 把 X 與 Y 當成向量輸入，抱歉，是當成矩陣。

cues.en: And I'm applying this function pdist, which is computing a distance metric between the matrix input.
cues.zh: 套用 pdist 函式，它計算輸入矩陣之間的距離指標。

cues.en: And then I'm specifying that the input should be cosine.
cues.zh: 指定使用 cosine 輸入。

cues.en: Now, MATLAB is actually returning the inverse of the cosine similarity, so that's why I say one minus the cosine distance to get the cosine similarity,
cues.zh: MATLAB 實際回傳的是餘弦相似度的反向形式，所以用 1 減餘弦距離，得到餘弦相似度。

cues.en: I hope that makes sense, so it's just, you know, the difference between distance and similarity is just a flip of the way you're thinking about it, and so a flip in the formula here.
cues.zh: 希望這樣說清楚了；距離與相似度只是思考方向相反，因此公式也反過來。

cues.en: Okay, so I'll just run this again, and then you see, of course, the exact numbers are changing because of random numbers, but they're overall doing the same thing, maybe this is also, I should get rid of this offset,
cues.zh: 再執行一次。因為隨機數，確切數字當然會改變，但整體相同。或許也應該去掉這個位移，

cues.en: and then we can see that this cosine similarity, which is the inverse of cosine distance, is the same thing as correlation coefficient here.
cues.zh: 如此可以看到，餘弦相似度，也就是與餘弦距離相反的形式，在這裡和相關係數相同。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do here to compare the correlation coefficient, the Pearson correlation coefficient, with cosine similarity is generate a bunch of different correlations,
cues.zh: 為了比較皮爾森相關係數與餘弦相似度，我要產生許多不同相關，

cues.en: or I should say data pairs, and then compute the correlation coefficient, that's what I do here.
cues.zh: 或者說許多資料配對，再計算相關係數，就是這裡做的事。

cues.en: So the correlation between x and y, these are random generated numbers.
cues.zh: 計算 X 與 Y 的相關，它們是隨機產生的數字。

cues.en: And then I'm computing the cosine similarity.
cues.zh: 接著計算餘弦相似度。

cues.en: So these are the lines of code that implement the cosine similarity as I wrote them out in the slides in the previous video,
cues.zh: 這幾行實作了上一支影片投影片中的餘弦相似度公式。

cues.en: so we have the numerator of cosine similarity is the sum of x times y, each element in x times each element in y summed up.
cues.zh: 分子是 X 乘 Y 的總和，也就是 X 各元素乘上 Y 對應元素，再加總。

cues.en: And then we have the denominator, which is, so this is actually the dot product between x and y in linear algebra terminology.
cues.zh: 接著是分母；剛才這部分，其實在線性代數中稱為 X 與 Y 的內積。

cues.en: And then we have the dot product, and that is the square root of the sum of x times x, so you can see it's really similar to the numerator, except we're doing x times x, and then the square root
cues.zh: 這裡也有內積，也就是 X 乘 X 的總和再開平方根；與分子很類似，只是改成 X 乘 X，再取平方根，

cues.en: of that and then times the square root of y times y.
cues.zh: 接著乘上 Y 乘 Y 的總和的平方根。

cues.en: And again, for the linear algebra enthusiasts, this is the norm of vector x and this is the norm of vector y.
cues.zh: 對線性代數愛好者而言，這是向量 X 的範數，這是向量 Y 的範數。

cues.en: And then, of course, the ratio between them is the cosine similarity, and let me comment this out for a moment.
cues.zh: 兩者的比值當然就是餘弦相似度，先把這裡註解掉一下。

cues.en: Okay, so then, let's see, so then here, these two lines of code are generating random data with a specified correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 這兩行產生具有指定相關係數的隨機資料。

cues.en: This is the same code that I used in a previous video in this section, that was the video on simulating data with a specified correlation.
cues.zh: 與本單元先前那支「模擬指定相關資料」影片的程式碼相同。

cues.en: Now I'm doing this over and over again for a range of theoretical or sort of requested correlation coefficient values,
cues.zh: 現在針對一系列理論上，或要求的相關係數值，反覆執行，

cues.en: and those are gonna go from minus one to plus one.
cues.zh: 範圍從負 1 到正 1。

cues.en: Now, the only reason why I'm doing this is, well, there's two reasons, one is, you know, just to get a bunch of data so we can see that the relation between correlation
cues.zh: 這樣做有兩個原因。首先，取得大量資料，讓我們對相關

cues.en: and cosine similarity is something that we will infer based on a lot of data, not just on one single point.
cues.zh: 與餘弦相似度關係的推論，基於許多資料，而不是單一資料點。

cues.en: And also because I wanna have a range of correlations so that you don't think that any meaningful relationship that we come across between the correlation
cues.zh: 其次，想有一系列相關，讓你不會以為相關

cues.en: and cosine similarity is some, you know, quirky unique feature that just happens to work when the correlation is zero or when the correlation is one or something like that.
cues.zh: 與餘弦相似度之間的任何有意義關係，只是相關為 0 或 1 時，才碰巧成立的特殊性質。

cues.en: Okay, so, and then there's some other stuff commented out and I'm gonna get back to that in a moment.
cues.zh: 其他部分先註解掉了，稍後會再回來。

cues.en: So run this cell, and then here, I'm just making some plots, so let's look at those plots.
cues.zh: 執行儲存格，這裡畫一些圖，來看看。

cues.en: So here on the x axis, I have the requested correlation, so that's the value of R that I specified.
cues.zh: X 軸是要求的相關，也就是指定的 r 值。

cues.en: Here is the empirical correlation, I guess I should call this the empirical correlation or cosine similarity.
cues.zh: 這是經驗相關，應該稱為經驗相關或餘弦相似度。

cues.en: And so you actually don't see really any blue lines here, any blue squares.
cues.zh: 這裡幾乎看不到任何藍線、藍色方塊。

cues.en: And that's because in this case, the correlation and the cosine similarity are pretty much identical.

cues.en: I can see on my screen, there's a little bit of divergence in here, maybe you can see it on your screen, or you'll see it when you run this code in Python.

cues.en: Now, the question is, why are these two measures, correlation and cosine similarity, nearly identical but not exactly identical everywhere?
cues.zh: 問題是，為什麼相關與餘弦相似度這兩個指標幾乎相同，卻不是處處完全相同？

cues.en: Why is that the case?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: If you would like to pause the video and think about that for a moment, then now is your opportunity to do that.
cues.zh: 如果想暫停影片思考，現在就是機會。

cues.en: So the answer, the reason why these are really similar but not exactly identical is that you'll remember from the formula in the previous slide that these two measures are exactly identical
cues.zh: 它們非常相似但不完全相同的原因是，記得前一張投影片的公式：這兩個指標會完全相同，

cues.en: when the data variables are already mean-centered, so when the variables have a mean of exactly zero.
cues.zh: 當資料變數已經平均中心化，也就是平均值精確為 0 時。

cues.en: And now we can look at how we're generating these data here.
cues.zh: 現在看看這裡產生資料的方法。

cues.en: So we generate normally distributed random numbers, so the expected mean is zero.
cues.zh: 產生的是常態分布的隨機數，所以期望平均值為 0。

cues.en: Of course, you know that the empirical mean, because of sampling variability and so on, it's not gonna be exactly zero, but it's gonna be pretty close to zero.
cues.zh: 你當然知道，因為抽樣變異等因素，經驗平均值不會精確為 0，但會非常接近。

cues.en: So the fact that the mean of these two variables is close to zero, but not exactly zero explains why these two lines are really similar but not exactly the same.
cues.zh: 兩個變數的平均值接近 0，卻不精確為 0，就解釋了為什麼兩條線非常相似，卻不完全相同。

cues.en: Okay, and here, we have a plot of the correlation coefficient by the cosine similarity for each of 100 individual data simulations.
cues.zh: 這裡把 100 次個別資料模擬的相關係數與餘弦相似度，畫在同一張圖。

cues.en: So you see they are pretty much exactly correlated.
cues.zh: 可以看到，它們幾乎完全相關。

cues.en: Now I'm gonna compute the correlation coefficient between them, and it's 0.99999679.
cues.zh: 現在計算兩者的相關係數，是 0.99999679。

cues.en: I think we can all agree that this is a pretty tight correlation, all right.
cues.zh: 我想大家都同意，這是非常緊密的相關。

cues.en: So now what I want to do is show where these two measures will start to differ somewhat.
cues.zh: 接著示範，兩個指標何時開始有些差異。

cues.en: And again, that is when there is a mean offset here.
cues.zh: 同樣，是這裡出現平均值位移時。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do is just add the number 10 to the data x.
cues.zh: 我要把數字 10 加到 X 資料上。

cues.en: Now, whether 10 on its own is a big offset or a small offset is all relative, but these data have a mean of zero and a variance of one.
cues.zh: 10 本身算大位移還是小位移，是相對的，但這些資料平均值是 0，變異數是 1。

cues.en: So in fact, adding 10 is a huge offset, that's a really, really big change to variable X.
cues.zh: 因此，加上 10 是巨大位移，對 X 是非常非常大的改變。

cues.en: So let's run this code again and visualize the results again.
cues.zh: 再執行一次，將結果視覺化。

cues.en: And now we start to see where these two measures are diverging.
cues.zh: 現在開始看到，兩個指標分開了。

cues.en: So the correlation, of course, is the same.
cues.zh: 相關當然一樣。

cues.en: Well, of course, you know, tiny differences because it's regenerating new random numbers, but the correlation pattern is exactly the same, and that makes sense because that's literally the formula
cues.zh: 因為重新產生隨機數，當然仍有微小差異，但相關模式完全相同。這很合理，因為相關係數的公式，

cues.en: of the correlation coefficient to subtract the mean.
cues.zh: 本來就是減掉平均值。

cues.en: It doesn't matter what kind of mean offset we add, it gets removed during the computation of the correlation.
cues.zh: 不論加入什麼平均值位移，計算相關時都會移除。

cues.en: But then we see that the cosine similarity now kind of follows the similar pattern, it's still, you know, overall starting at minus one, or sorry, starting at negative numbers
cues.zh: 但餘弦相似度雖然仍遵循類似模式，整體從負 1 開始——抱歉，是從負數開始，

cues.en: and going up to positive numbers.
cues.zh: 上升到正數，

cues.en: But it's a really restricted range, and then if we look down here, we can see, okay, well, the scale is a little annoying here, let me comment this out and plot this again.
cues.zh: 範圍卻非常受限。往下看，這個尺度有點麻煩，先註解這裡，再畫一次。

cues.en: So we can see there's still a really strong, robust correlation between the Pearson correlation coefficient and cosine similarity.
cues.zh: 可以看到，皮爾森相關係數與餘弦相似度之間，仍有很強、很穩健的相關。

cues.en: So they're both negative in the same parts, they're both positive in the same places, a little bit of noise notwithstanding here.
cues.zh: 除了有些雜訊，它們在相同區域都是負值，在相同區域都是正值。

cues.en: But they are more different from each other compared to the previous version where the means of the variables was close to zero.
cues.zh: 不過，與先前變數平均值接近 0 的版本相比，兩者差異更大。

cues.en: And then we can quantify this relationship, and now the correlation is 0.76.
cues.zh: 把這個關係量化，現在相關為 0.76。

cues.en: So that's still a pretty strong correlation, although certainly not identical, so these are no longer really the same, but they are very similar.
cues.zh: 仍然相當強，雖然顯然不完全相同；兩者不再真正一樣，但非常相似。

cues.en: Okay, so now, you know, let's meditate on this for a few moments, why are these differences there and is one measure quote unquote right
cues.zh: 現在稍微思考一下，為什麼會有這些差異，是不是一個指標「正確」，

cues.en: and the other one quote unquote wrong?
cues.zh: 另一個「錯誤」？

cues.en: Well, obviously, neither one is better or worse or right or wrong, they're both correct, they just tell us slightly different things, they're based on slightly different assumptions
cues.zh: 顯然，沒有哪個比較好、比較差、正確或錯誤。它們都正確，只是告訴我們稍微不同的事情，也對資料

cues.en: about the data and what we make of the data.
cues.zh: 以及我們如何看待資料，採用稍微不同的假設。

cues.en: So from the perspective of the Pearson correlation coefficient, what we care about is whether the data values are generally going up and down together
cues.zh: 從皮爾森相關係數的角度，我們關心資料值是否大致一起上下變化，

cues.en: and whether large jumps are seen in both variables, and whether small jumps are seen in both variables at the same time.
cues.zh: 兩個變數是否都出現大幅跳動，以及是否同時出現小幅跳動。

cues.en: So this is designed for being able to compare across different kinds of measures, so imagine you want to correlate height and weight.
cues.zh: 這是為了能比較不同種類的量測，例如想計算身高與體重的相關。

cues.en: Well, you know, we measure height in inches or centimeters, we measure weight in pounds or kilos, but we can also measure weight in terms of grams or picograms.
cues.zh: 身高用英吋或公分，體重用磅或公斤，也可以用公克或皮克量測。

cues.en: And all of those measurements don't actually change the fundamental relationships, the relationships stay the same, although the numbers,
cues.zh: 所有這些量測都不會改變根本關係；關係保持不變，雖然數字，

cues.en: the scaling of the numbers might differ.
cues.zh: 也就是數字的尺度可能不同。

cues.en: And from the perspective of the correlation coefficient, none of that matters, what matters is whether these two variables are generally going up and down together.
cues.zh: 從相關係數的角度，這些都不重要，重要的是兩個變數是否大致一起上下變化。

cues.en: Okay, so that's for the correlation, and then we get to cosine similarity and there, the perspective is a little bit different, the perspective from cosine similarity is that,
cues.zh: 餘弦相似度的角度則稍有不同。

cues.en: if you add the number 10 to the variable x, now x and y are less similar to each other because they have different scale ranges,
cues.zh: 如果把 10 加到 X，現在 X 與 Y 彼此較不相似，因為尺度範圍不同，

cues.en: the scales are in a different range.
cues.zh: 尺度落在不同範圍。

cues.en: So it's hard to say that one of these is better or worse than the other.
cues.zh: 因此很難說，哪一個比較好、哪一個比較差。

cues.en: But I hope you can now appreciate that correlation and cosine similarity are very close, they're very similar concepts, but the way
cues.zh: 希望你現在能理解，相關與餘弦相似度非常接近、概念非常相似，但對相似性的

cues.en: that they conceptualize and operationalize similarity is slightly different between the two.
cues.zh: 概念化與操作化定義，兩者稍有不同。

cues.en: Okay, so that is almost the end of this video, the one thing I want to add is that there is, of course, a built-in function in Python to compute cosine similarity,
cues.zh: 這支影片快結束了。最後補充，Python 當然也有計算餘弦相似度的內建函式，

cues.en: this is so you can see how straightforward it is based on the formula that I showed.
cues.zh: 這裡只是讓你看到，從投影片公式實作其實很直接。

cues.en: And you can also use the, so this is the spatial module, which is in the SciPy toolbox, so you see here I'm importing that.
cues.zh: 也可以使用 spatial 模組，它在 SciPy 工具箱裡，可以看到這裡匯入了它。

cues.en: So Python doesn't actually compute cosine similarity per se, instead, it's computing cosine distance,
cues.zh: Python 實際計算的並非餘弦相似度本身，而是餘弦距離，

cues.en: which is literally just the opposite of cosine similarity.
cues.zh: 也就是與餘弦相似度相反的量。

cues.en: So that's why I have the one minus here, in fact, let me do this, I'll illustrate it this way.
cues.zh: 所以這裡有 1 減。實際示範一下，改成這樣。

cues.en: So now this variable here, it gets computed, but then it gets even commented out, it's not really necessary, but we can do that.
cues.zh: 現在這個變數會計算，但之後又註解掉，其實不太必要，不過可以這樣做。

cues.en: Let me see, let me do it this way.
cues.zh: 看看，改成這種方式。

cues.en: So now I am not going to compute the cosine similarity, I'm gonna compute cosine distance, and we can see how that's plotted, so it looks like,
cues.zh: 現在不計算餘弦相似度，而是計算餘弦距離，看看畫出來的結果。

cues.en: you know, these are exactly opposite of each other.
cues.zh: 兩者剛好方向相反。

cues.zh: 但用 1 減距離，也就是相似度時，它們就再次重疊，基本上相同。
